section: Opus code-reviewer on the two planning documents (verdict REVISE, all seven findings fixed in this diff)

review.finding: Start condition 6 says budget = none satisfies programme 2.4, but 2.4 also asks for the L2 time budget, which was not mentioned.
review.suggestion: Say that none also covers the L2 time budget. Fixed.

review.finding: The LEARNINGS file is appended to by every unit but is in no unit's touch set.
review.suggestion: Add it to P0's touch set and say it never counts toward observable files. Fixed.

review.finding: fr_split listed as generic although it needs FR/AC and the AC-Move-Map, which the same sentence defines as Shipwright-specific.
review.suggestion: Move fr_split and the promise lock's AC-id resolution to Shipwright-specific. Fixed.

review.finding: Start condition 4 cites the 2026-11-08 atomic-frs check only; a newer check (2026-11-11) exists.
Pins 'unchanged by #1033 and #1054' is more than the measurement shows (it compares two dates with other merges between).
review.suggestion: Reword to unchanged since 2026-11-09. Fixed in both files.

review.finding: Section 8 sits before section 7 and the rev 6 log entry is at the top of an oldest-first log.
review.suggestion: Move section 8 after 7 and append the entry last. Fixed.

review.finding: Section 8 says stop 3 reads LEARNINGS but the P7-op hand-over names only the findings report.
review.suggestion: Add LEARNINGS to the hand-over. Fixed.
